description: A chain of eight countdowns that take turns on the clock, producing bursts of triggers and gates

params.text: Advances the chain one count, as a rising edge at the clock jack does
Sets every counter back to its starting value and stops all the outputs
Starts the chain running, and stops it again on a second press
In the Once position the chain stops when the last counter runs out; in Loop it starts again on the next clock
Sets how many clocks that counter runs for, 0 to 64; a counter set to 0 is skipped

inputs.text: A rising edge here advances the chain one count
A rising edge here sets every counter back to its starting value
A rising edge here starts the chain running, and a second edge stops it

outputs.text: Sends a 1ms pulse on every clock that counter takes
Goes to 10V while the clock is high and that counter is the one currently counting
Sends a 1ms pulse on every clock any counter takes
Follows the clock input, 10V while the clock is high and 0V while it is low, whether or not a counter is running
Sends a 1ms pulse when the last counter with a non-zero setting reaches zero

notes: nothing happens until the chain is started: set at least one counter above zero, then press or trigger Start, and the green lamp beside it shows the chain is running
only one counter runs at a time. The chain works down from the first, and a counter starts only when the one before it has reached zero
the global gate follows the clock input directly rather than reporting whether any counter is active, which is not what the maker's README describes

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
